lines.lyric_hangul: 어리게 보이기 싫어서
lines.lyric_translation: I didn’t wanna seem young

lines.lyric: Gwaenhi jitgujeun otman gyesok bakkwo ipgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜히 짓궂은 옷만 계속 바꿔 입고
lines.lyric_translation: So I just kept changing clothes for no reason

lines.lyric_hangul: 어른스럽고만 싶어서
lines.lyric_translation: I wanted to be an adult

lines.lyric: Gwaenhi an bodeon nyuseureul da bogo
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜히 안 보던 뉴스를 다 보고
lines.lyric_translation: So I watched the news for no reason

lines.lyric: Undonghwaeseo deo joeun guduro nungireul dollyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 운동화에서 더 좋은 구두로 눈길을 돌려
lines.lyric_translation: My eyes went from sneakers to dress shoes

lines.lyric: Manyang gireotteon haruga yosaeneun mwonga jjalge neukkyeojyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 마냥 길었던 하루가 요새는 뭔가 짧게 느껴져
lines.lyric_translation: Days that used to feel long now feel so short

lines.lyric_hangul: 학교 쉬는 시간 종이 치자마자, 매점으로 달려갔던
lines.lyric_translation: As soon as the bell rang for break time / I used to run to the food cart

lines.lyric: Nae balgeoreumeun jeomjeom chojohaejigo tteolligo isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 발걸음은 점점 초조해지고 떨리고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: But now, my footsteps are pitiful and trembling

lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 민증을 받게 되면
lines.lyric_translation: When I finally get my ID card

lines.lyric_hangul: 기쁜 마음을 감추기 바쁠듯해
lines.lyric_translation: It’ll be hard to hide my joy

lines.lyric: Geudongan mothae eorin tireul mot naeneun cheok
lines.lyric_hangul: 그동안 못해 어린 티를 못 내는 척
lines.lyric_translation: All the times I acted like I couldn’t act like a kid

lines.lyric_hangul: 삐뚤어진 듯 반듯해
lines.lyric_translation: As if I’m crooked yet straight

lines.lyric_hangul: 시간이 있어도, 바쁜 척 허세만 늘어가고
lines.lyric_translation: Acting like I’m busy even though I have time / Only my arrogance grew

lines.lyric: Seumul sariraneun naineun baro nae munteok ape isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 스무 살이라는 나이는 바로 내 문턱 앞에 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I’m at the cusp of twenty

lines.lyric: Nae naidaero sallae naturally ey ey
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 나이대로 살래 naturally, ayy, ayy
lines.lyric_translation: I wanna live my age, naturally ey ey

lines.lyric: Eorin nalgaero nallae spread my wings ey ey
lines.lyric_hangul: 어린 날개로 날래, spread my wings, ayy, ayy
lines.lyric_translation: Fly with my young wings, spread my wings ey ey

lines.lyric: Eoreunin cheok hal ttaega joeundeuthae an byeonhallae
lines.lyric_hangul: 어른인 척 할 때가 좋은듯해, 안 변할래
lines.lyric_translation: It was nice when I acted like an adult

lines.lyric_hangul: 철부지 같다는 말 듣는데도
lines.lyric_translation: But I don’t wanna change, even if they say I’m immature

lines.lyric_hangul: 뭐든 서툴지만 처음이란 단어가 좋아
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I’m bad at it, I like the word, beginning

lines.lyric_hangul: 어리숙하지만 이대로만
lines.lyric_translation: It’s foolish but i’m still young

lines.lyric_hangul: 아직 어린 난 지금은 어려워
lines.lyric_translation: It’s hard to become an adult now

lines.lyric_hangul: 어른이 된단 말 올까 봐 두려워
lines.lyric_translation: I’m afraid that the day I become an adult will come

lines.lyric_hangul: 어른이 되는 날
lines.lyric_translation: The day I become an adult

lines.lyric_hangul: 문방구의 단골 손님, 이젠 발길은 가로수길
lines.lyric_translation: I used to be a regular at the stationery store / But now I’m headed towards Garosugil

lines.lyric_hangul: 더 좋은 것에 눈 돌리는 거에 그치지 않고, 눈독을 들여
lines.lyric_translation: Rather than stopping at turning my eyes to nice things / There’s poison in my eyes now

parts.lyric: Deo joeun geose nun dollineun geoe

lines.lyric_hangul: 이렇듯, 어른인 척 다, 큰 척, 다른 의미의 척척박사가
lines.lyric_translation: Acting like an adult, like I’m all grown up / Like I know what everything means

parts.lyric: Ireoteut eoreunin cheok da keun cheok

lines.lyric: Dweeotjiman maksang nunape dagaoni pyojeongi beongjjyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 되었지만 막상 눈앞에 다가오니, 표정이 벙쪄
lines.lyric_translation: But now that the time is actually near, I don’t know what to do

lines.lyric: Sae hakgi shijak jeone chaek da chaenggyeosseul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 새 학기 시작 전에 책 다 챙겼을 때
lines.lyric_translation: When the new semester started and I gathered all my books

lines.lyric_hangul: 것도 무겁다며 반 앞 소화전에다 내려 놨었는데
lines.lyric_translation: I used to think it’s too heavy / And put it down in front of the classroom

lines.lyric_hangul: 어른이 된 후 짊어져야 하는 건 몇 배 더 무거운 책임
lines.lyric_translation: Now that I’m an adult / Responsibilities are even heavier

parts.lyric: Eoreuni dwen hu jilmeojyeoya haneun geon

lines.lyric: Junbi an dwen nan geokjeongi baegim
lines.lyric_hangul: 준비 안 된, 난 걱정이 백임
lines.lyric_translation: I’m not ready, only filled with worries
